name: Defias Tower Key
summary: The Defias Tower Key is an item stolen from the monstrous sentries guarding Klaven's Tower in Westfall. Carried by the mutated drones defending the site, it represents vital proof of the Defias Brotherhood's dangerous operations and is sought by Stormwind intelligence operatives.

sections.title: A Prize from the Twisted Guard
sections.body: Klaven's Tower along the Westfall coastline has long served as a stronghold for the Defias Brotherhood, but recent shipments out of Duskwood brought far more terrifying sentries to its perimeter. Among the guards are malformed Defias drones—undead, spike-ridden abominations. To pierce the defenses and prove the perimeter breached, SI:7 operatives stake out the grounds and mandate that field agents pick the pockets of these grotesque sentinels rather than engage them head-on. The key serves as clear evidence that an infiltrator penetrated the perimeter without sounding an alarm.

sections.title: Uncovering the Duskwood Connection
sections.body: Recovering this key marks the first step in unveiling an unnatural conspiracy reaching far beyond typical highway robbery. Inside the tower sits a chest bound with shipments from Duskwood, holding Klaven Mortwake's Journal. When brought to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind, the mission reveals how the Defias conspired with the Venture Company to traffic specialized troll poisons discovered by Zanzil the Outcast. These mixtures allow alchemists to simulate undeath, explaining the grotesque, coughing abominations stationed around the tower.

faq.q: How do you obtain the Defias Tower Key?
aliases: where do i get the key
how to get defias tower key
faq.answer: The key cannot be looted from a defeated enemy. An operative must sneak close and pickpocket one of the malformed Defias drones guarding the exterior of Klaven's Tower in Westfall.

faq.q: What does the Defias Tower Key open?
aliases: does it open the duskwood chest
faq.answer: The key does not physically unlock the tower door or the Duskwood Chest inside. Instead, it serves as an intelligence token required by Master Mathias Shaw to verify that an operative successfully infiltrated the perimeter undetected.

faq.q: What are the malformed Defias drones guarding the tower?
faq.answer: They are grotesque, spiked undead guards stationed around Klaven's Tower. Agent Kearnen does not know what made them and asks operatives to investigate the shipment they guard.

faq.q: Who sends operatives to retrieve this key?
faq.answer: Agent Kearnen, an SI:7 scout staking out the perimeter of Klaven's Tower, directs field rogues to acquire the key and retrieve the contents of the Duskwood Chest for Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

angles.text: Acquiring the Defias Tower Key is a quintessential trial for rogues working with SI:7, demanding mastery of stealth, pickpocketing, and an understanding of lethal poisons.
Securing intelligence from Klaven's Tower helps Stormwind investigate the Defias Brotherhood's strange shipments from Duskwood.
